Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: San Francisco central retail and commercial corridor anchored by Union Square, Market Street transit, and high-density hotel flagships.

SoMa.name: SoMa
SoMa.description: South of Market tech campus core and cultural anchor with high-density residential towers, Moscone Center, and adaptive warehouse conversions.

Financial District.name: Financial District
Financial District.description: West Coast banking capital and high-rise commercial hub featuring the Transamerica Pyramid, Salesforce Tower, and premium office towers.

Mission.name: Mission
Mission.description: Historic cultural and culinary corridor centered on Valencia and Mission streets with vibrant murals, Michelin-starred dining, and transit access.

Hayes Valley.name: Hayes Valley
Hayes Valley.description: Boutique shopping and arts enclave adjacent to the Civic Center performing arts complex with high pedestrian activity and designer retail.

Marina.name: Marina
Marina.description: Scenic bayfront district featuring Mediterranean-style architecture, Chestnut Street shopping, Palace of Fine Arts, and Marina Green parkland.

Mission Bay.name: Mission Bay
Mission Bay.description: Master-planned life sciences and healthcare district anchored by UCSF Mission Bay medical campus and the Golden State Warriors Chase Center.

Dogpatch.name: Dogpatch
Dogpatch.description: Historic maritime and industrial neighborhood along Third Street transformed into an artisanal manufacturing, brewery, and contemporary loft district.

Potrero Hill.name: Potrero Hill
Potrero Hill.description: Sunny residential neighborhood with dramatic skyline vistas, 18th Street village retail, and design showroom conversions.

North Beach.name: North Beach
North Beach.description: San Francisco's historic Little Italy and Beat Generation enclave along Columbus Avenue with dense trattorias, cafes, and historic nightlife.

Pacific Heights.name: Pacific Heights
Pacific Heights.description: Prestigious hilltop enclave known for Billionaire's Row mansions, Fillmore Street upscale retail, and sweeping views of the Golden Gate.

Castro.name: Castro
Castro.description: World-renowned historic LGBTQ+ cultural capital centered on Castro and 18th streets with iconic Victorian architecture and active retail corridors.

Sunset.name: Sunset
Sunset.description: Expansive coastal residential district bordered by Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach with vibrant commercial spines on Irving, Judah, and Noriega.

Richmond.name: Richmond
Richmond.description: Northwest residential district along Clement and Geary boulevards featuring exceptional culinary diversity, park access, and multi-family infill.

Nob Hill.name: Nob Hill
Nob Hill.description: Historic luxury hilltop neighborhood crowned by landmark hotels (Fairmont, Mark Hopkins), Grace Cathedral, and historic cable car lines.

Tenderloin.name: Tenderloin
Tenderloin.description: Historic central district featuring dense SRO and apartment stock, Little Saigon culinary spine, and emerging arts venues.

Presidio.name: Presidio
Presidio.description: Former military garrison turned iconic national parkland with historic officer quarters, Lucasfilm campus, and Presidio Tunnel Tops.

Downtown Oakland.name: Downtown Oakland
Downtown Oakland.description: Civic and commercial heart of the East Bay centered around City Center, BART transit hub, and major residential high-rises.

Uptown Oakland.name: Uptown Oakland
Uptown Oakland.description: Premier entertainment and arts district featuring the Fox and Paramount Theatres, Telegraph Avenue dining, and creative headquarters.

Jack London Square.name: Jack London Square
Jack London Square.description: Historic waterfront dining, ferry terminal, and logistics-adjacent development corridor along the Oakland Estuary.

Berkeley Downtown.name: Berkeley Downtown
Berkeley Downtown.description: UC Berkeley gateway and transit center with Shattuck Avenue retail, Berkeley Rep arts anchors, and dense student housing development.

West Berkeley.name: West Berkeley
West Berkeley.description: Artisanal, biotech, and retail corridor along Fourth Street with light industrial conversions and innovative makerspaces.

Rockridge.name: Rockridge
Rockridge.description: Affluent North Oakland neighborhood along College Avenue featuring gourmet dining, bookstore boutiques, and BART transit connectivity.

Temescal.name: Temescal
Temescal.description: Trendy culinary corridor along Telegraph Avenue featuring Temescal Alleys, artisanal food scene, and transit-oriented infill.

Emeryville.name: Emeryville
Emeryville.description: Biotech, animation (Pixar), and major retail center between Oakland and Berkeley with high-density mixed-use development.

Alameda.name: Alameda
Alameda.description: Island city community known for Victorian architecture, historic Park and Webster street retail, and Alameda Point waterfront reuse.

Fremont Downtown.name: Fremont Downtown
Fremont Downtown.description: Major East Bay tech manufacturing and residential hub centered around Capitol Avenue, BART, and Tesla Gigafactory corridor.

Hayward Downtown.name: Hayward Downtown
Hayward Downtown.description: Central East Bay transit corridor featuring historic B Street revitalization, Cal State East Bay connectivity, and mixed-use housing.

San Leandro Downtown.name: San Leandro Downtown
San Leandro Downtown.description: Tech campus and 3D printing/industrial tech center along East 14th Street with TOD development near BART.

Richmond CA.name: Richmond CA
Richmond CA.description: North Bay / East Bay gateway featuring Macdonald Avenue revitalization, Richmond Ferry Terminal, and waterfront industrial reuse.

Walnut Creek Downtown.name: Walnut Creek Downtown
Walnut Creek Downtown.description: Premier Contra Costa commercial and luxury shopping destination anchored by Broadway Plaza, high-density residential, and BART.

Concord Downtown.name: Concord Downtown
Concord Downtown.description: Todos Santos Plaza dining and community core with major BART connectivity and regional transit-oriented infill.

Pleasanton Downtown.name: Pleasanton Downtown
Pleasanton Downtown.description: Historic Main Street Tri-Valley enclave and Hacienda Business Park corporate campus anchor with affluent demographics.

Dublin Downtown.name: Dublin Downtown
Dublin Downtown.description: Rapidly expanding Tri-Valley commercial core at the I-580/I-680 junction with modern master-planned residential communities.

Livermore Downtown.name: Livermore Downtown
Livermore Downtown.description: Eastern Tri-Valley wine country and national laboratory (LLNL) technology anchor featuring a vibrant First Street cultural corridor.

San Mateo Downtown.name: San Mateo Downtown
San Mateo Downtown.description: Vibrant Peninsula dining hub centered on 3rd and 4th avenues with Central Park, Caltrain station, and tech office infill.

Burlingame Ave.name: Burlingame Ave
Burlingame Ave.description: Upscale Peninsula retail and dining corridor known for tree-lined streetscapes, luxury boutiques, and affluent demographics.

Redwood City Downtown.name: Redwood City Downtown
Redwood City Downtown.description: 'Climate Best by Government Test' county seat experiencing significant downtown tech office expansion and transit-oriented housing.

Menlo Park.name: Menlo Park
Menlo Park.description: Venture capital capital on Sand Hill Road with Santa Cruz Avenue downtown retail and Meta global headquarters.

South San Francisco.name: South San Francisco
South San Francisco.description: 'The Birthplace of Biotechnology' featuring the world's premier life sciences cluster around Oyster Point and Grand Avenue downtown.

Daly City.name: Daly City
Daly City.description: 'Gateway to the Peninsula' with Westlake Shopping Center, major BART transit hub, and dense multi-family residential communities.

San Bruno.name: San Bruno
San Bruno.description: YouTube global headquarters campus and San Mateo Avenue commercial district adjacent to SFO International Airport.

Palo Alto University Ave.name: Palo Alto University Ave
Palo Alto University Ave.description: Stanford University commercial anchor and global startup epicenter with prestigious University Avenue dining and tech office presence.

Mountain View Castro St.name: Mountain View Castro St
Mountain View Castro St.description: Castro Street dining corridor and Caltrain/VTA transit hub anchored by Googleplex and surrounding tech innovation hubs.

Sunnyvale Downtown.name: Sunnyvale Downtown
Sunnyvale Downtown.description: Historic Murphy Avenue and modern CityLine town center development in the heart of Silicon Valley defense and aerospace/tech corridor.

Downtown San Jose.name: Downtown San Jose
Downtown San Jose.description: Capital of Silicon Valley featuring San Pedro Square Market, Adobe headquarters towers, SAP Center, and major high-rise housing.

Santana Row.name: Santana Row
Santana Row.description: Premier European-style luxury lifestyle district combining flagship luxury retail, fine dining, Class A creative office, and residential lofts.

Cupertino.name: Cupertino
Cupertino.description: Global headquarters of Apple Inc. featuring Apple Park, Main Street Cupertino mixed-use core, and top-tier educational institutions.

Santa Clara.name: Santa Clara
Santa Clara.description: Silicon Valley technology powerhouse anchored by Intel headquarters, Nvidia campus, Santa Clara University, and Levi's Stadium corridor.

North San Jose.name: North San Jose
North San Jose.description: Major technology innovation corridor along North First Street featuring Cisco headquarters, major R&D campuses, and VTA transit.

Sausalito.name: Sausalito
Sausalito.description: Picturesque waterfront town across the Golden Gate with Bridgeway promenade shopping, ferry connectivity, and historic houseboat enclaves.

Mill Valley.name: Mill Valley
Mill Valley.description: Redwood-canopied enclave at the base of Mount Tamalpais with historic downtown plaza, boutique retail, and outdoor recreation access.

San Rafael Downtown.name: San Rafael Downtown
San Rafael Downtown.description: Marin County's economic and transit center along Fourth Street with SMART rail station, cultural district, and bio/gaming development.

Corte Madera.name: Corte Madera
